symbols.name: exclusive or
symbols.meaning: The addition of the binary field, which gives 1 exactly when its two bits differ.
symbols.quote: Its addition is exclusive or ($\oplus$), which gives $1$ exactly when its two bits differ

symbols.name: three-element subset
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set, one of the two subsets compared for being neighbours.
symbols.quote: In the bit construction, two three-element subsets $\mathcal{A}$ and $\mathcal{C}$ of the ground set are neighbours when they share exactly one element.

symbols.name: three-element subset
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set, the second of the two subsets compared for being neighbours.
symbols.quote: In the bit construction, two three-element subsets $\mathcal{A}$ and $\mathcal{C}$ of the ground set are neighbours when they share exactly one element.

relations.quote: The addition of $\mathbb{F}_2$ is defined by [Congruence](congruence-modulo.md) modulo $2$.
